reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a performed behavior — the car pulling forward out of the dark — so the action is request-governed; the only supplied asset is an audio engine rumble, which cannot supply a visual action.
reasons.medium: No visual reference was supplied; the sole reference is audio (a low engine rumble) and the medium decision already settles that no reference governs the rendering family, leaving the medium to the request.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference and no wardrobe request exist; with nothing observed and nothing specified, wardrobe remains request-governed space.
reasons.lighting: With no visual reference, the brief's staging of the car emerging out of the dark is the only lighting guidance available, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference exists and no actual camera composition is observed; the 16:9 canvas is a delivery ratio rather than an instruction, so framing stays request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference exists and the request supplies no color or grading instruction beyond darkness, so palette is governed by the request.
